017package org.wpilib.util.collections;
018
019import java.util.Collection;
020import java.util.Iterator;
021import java.util.Map;
022import java.util.PrimitiveIterator;
023import java.util.Set;
024import java.util.stream.IntStream;
025
026/**
027 * An object that maps String prefixes to values. A PrefixMap cannot contain duplicate prefixes;
028 * each prefix can map to at most one value.
029 *
030 * <p>The PrefixMap is a key-value type collection where the key is assumed to be the prefix of the
031 * String for which later an answer is requested.
032 *
033 * <p>So the retrieval of the value is based on a startsWith() check of the requested <code>input
034 * </code> against each of the stored <code>prefixes</code>. The value associated with the selected
035 * prefix is then returned.
036 *
037 * <p>An example use case is where mobile phone device models of a certain brand all start with the
038 * same substring. This data structure can be used to efficiently retrieve the best fitting prefix
039 * to find the associated value (i.e. the brand of the device).
040 *
041 * @param <V> value type
042 */
043public interface PrefixMap<V> extends Map<String, V> {
044  /**
045   * Return the number of prefix-value mappings in this prefixmap.
046   *
047   * @return the number of prefix-value mappings in this prefixmap
048   */
049  @Override
050  int size();
051
052  /**
053   * Return true if empty.
054   *
055   * @return <b>true</b> if empty.
056   */
057  @Override
058  default boolean isEmpty() {
059    return size() == 0;
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Copies all of the mappings from the specified map to this prefixmap.
064   *
065   * @param prefixesAndValues mappings to be stored in this map
066   * @throws NullPointerException if one or more of the prefixes or values are null. If this happens
067   *     the PrefixMap is in an undefined state.
068   */
069  @Override
070  default void putAll(Map<? extends String, ? extends V> prefixesAndValues) {
071    prefixesAndValues.forEach(this::put);
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Stored the specified value as the result for the specified prefix.
076   *
077   * <p>If for the specified prefix previously a value was present then the old value is replaced
078   * with the new value and the old value is returned.
079   *
080   * @param prefix prefix with which the specified value is to be associated
081   * @param value value to be associated with the specified prefix
082   * @return the previous value of the specified <code>prefix</code>, or <code>null</code> if there
083   *     was no mapping for <code>prefix</code>.
084   * @throws NullPointerException if either the prefix or value are null. If this happens the
085   *     PrefixMap is unchanged.
086   */
087  @Override
088  V put(String prefix, V value);
089
090  /**
091   * Removes the mapping for a prefix if present.
092   *
093   * @param prefix prefix whose mapping is to be removed from the prefixmap
094   * @return the previous value associated with <code>prefix</code> (may be null).
095   * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if not implemented.
096   */
097  default V remove(String prefix) {
098    throw new UnsupportedOperationException(
099        "The 'remove(String prefix)' method has not been implemented in "
100            + this.getClass().getCanonicalName());
101  }
102
103  @Override
104  default V remove(Object o) {
105    if (o instanceof String) {
106      return remove((String) o);
107    }
108    return null;
109  }
110
111  @Override
112  default boolean containsKey(Object o) {
113    throw new UnsupportedOperationException(
114        "The 'containsKey(Object o)' method has not been implemented in "
115            + this.getClass().getCanonicalName());
116  }
117
118  @Override
119  default boolean containsValue(Object o) {
120    throw new UnsupportedOperationException(
121        "The 'containsValue(Object o)' method has not been implemented in "
122            + this.getClass().getCanonicalName());
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * Return the value of the <code>exact</code> matching prefix.
127   *
128   * <p>The value returned is the stored prefix for which is true: <code>input.equals(prefix)</code>
129   * .
130   *
131   * @param prefix The string for which we need value of the stored prefix
132   * @return The value, null if not found.
133   */
134  V get(String prefix);
135
136  /**
137   * Return the value of the <code>exact</code> matching prefix.
138   *
139   * <p>The value returned is the stored prefix for which is true: <code>input.equals(prefix)</code>
140   * .
141   *
142   * @param prefix The string for which we need the stored value
143   * @return The value, null if not found.
144   */
145  @Override
146  default V get(Object prefix) {
147    if (prefix instanceof String) {
148      return get((String) prefix);
149    }
150    return null;
151  }
152
153  @Override
154  default Set<String> keySet() {
155    throw new UnsupportedOperationException(
156        "The 'keySet()' method has not been implemented in " + this.getClass().getCanonicalName());
157  }
158
159  @Override
160  default Collection<V> values() {
161    throw new UnsupportedOperationException(
162        "The 'values()' method has not been implemented in " + this.getClass().getCanonicalName());
163  }
164
165  /**
166   * The prefixmap will be empty after this call returns.
167   *
168   * @throws UnsupportedOperationException if the <code>clear</code> operation is not supported by
169   *     this map
170   */
171  @Override
172  default void clear() {
173    throw new UnsupportedOperationException(
174        "The 'clear()' method has not been implemented in " + this.getClass().getCanonicalName());
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * Returns <code>true</code> if this map contains an exact mapping for the specified prefix.
179   *
180   * @param prefix prefix whose presence in this prefixmap is to be checked
181   * @return <code>true</code> if this map contains an the exact mapping for the specified prefix.
182   */
183  default boolean containsPrefix(String prefix) {
184    return containsPrefix(prefix.codePoints().iterator());
185  }
186
187  /**
188   * Returns <code>true</code> if this map contains an exact mapping for the specified prefix.
189   *
190   * @param prefix prefix whose presence in this prefixmap is to be checked
191   * @return <code>true</code> if this map contains an the exact mapping for the specified prefix.
192   */
193  default boolean containsPrefix(int[] prefix) {
194    return containsPrefix(IntStream.of(prefix).iterator());
195  }
196
197  /**
198   * Returns <code>true</code> if this map contains an exact mapping for the specified prefix.
199   *
200   * @param prefix prefix whose presence in this prefixmap is to be checked
201   * @return <code>true</code> if this map contains an the exact mapping for the specified prefix.
202   */
203  boolean containsPrefix(PrimitiveIterator.OfInt prefix);
204
205  /**
206   * Return the value of the <code>shortest</code> matching prefix.
207   *
208   * <p>The value returned is the shortest stored prefix for which is true: <code>
209   * input.startsWith(prefix)</code>.
210   *
211   * @param input The string for which we need value of the stored prefix
212   * @return The value, null if not found.
213   */
214  default V getShortestMatch(String input) {
215    return getShortestMatch(input.codePoints().iterator());
216  }
217
218  /**
219   * Return the value of the <code>shortest</code> matching prefix.
220   *
221   * <p>The value returned is the shortest stored prefix for which is true: <code>
222   * input.startsWith(prefix)</code>.
223   *
224   * @param input The string (iterator of Unicode CodePoints) for which we need value of the stored
225   *     prefix.
226   * @return The value, null if not found.
227   */
228  default V getShortestMatch(int[] input) {
229    return getShortestMatch(IntStream.of(input).iterator());
230  }
231
232  /**
233   * Return the value of the <code>shortest</code> matching prefix.
234   *
235   * <p>The value returned is the shortest stored prefix for which is true: <code>
236   * input.startsWith(prefix)</code>.
237   *
238   * @param input The string (iterator of Unicode CodePoints) for which we need value of the stored
239   *     prefix.
240   * @return The value, null if not found.
241   */
242  V getShortestMatch(PrimitiveIterator.OfInt input);
243
244  /**
245   * Return the value of the longest matching prefix.
246   *
247   * <p>The value returned is the longest stored prefix for which is true: <code>
248   * input.startsWith(prefix)</code>.
249   *
250   * @param input The string for which we need value of the stored prefix
251   * @return The value, null if not found.
252   */
253  default V getLongestMatch(String input) {
254    return getLongestMatch(input.codePoints().iterator());
255  }
256
257  /**
258   * Return the value of the longest matching prefix.
259   *
260   * <p>The value returned is the longest stored prefix for which is true: <code>
261   * input.startsWith(prefix)</code>.
262   *
263   * @param input The string (iterator of Unicode CodePoints) for which we need value of the stored
264   *     prefix.
265   * @return The value, null if not found.
266   */
267  default V getLongestMatch(int[] input) {
268    return getLongestMatch(IntStream.of(input).iterator());
269  }
270
271  /**
272   * Return the value of the longest matching prefix.
273   *
274   * <p>The value returned is the longest stored prefix for which is true: <code>
275   * input.startsWith(prefix)</code>.
276   *
277   * @param input The string (iterator of Unicode CodePoints) for which we need value of the stored
278   *     prefix.
279   * @return The value, null if not found.
280   */
281  V getLongestMatch(PrimitiveIterator.OfInt input);
282
283  /**
284   * Returns List of all matches that have a value.
285   *
286   * <p>The list contains all non-null values for the prefix values where this is true: <code>
287   * input.startsWith(prefix)</code>.
288   *
289   * @param input The string for which we need value of the stored prefix
290   * @return The list of values, an empty List if nothing is found.
291   */
292  default Iterator<V> getAllMatches(String input) {
293    return getAllMatches(input.codePoints().iterator());
294  }
295
296  /**
297   * Returns List of all matches that have a value.
298   *
299   * <p>The list contains all non-null values for the prefix values where this is true: <code>
300   * input.startsWith(prefix)</code>.
301   *
302   * @param input The string (iterator of Unicode CodePoints) for which we need value of the stored
303   *     prefix.
304   * @return The list of values, an empty List if nothing is found.
305   */
306  default Iterator<V> getAllMatches(int[] input) {
307    return getAllMatches(IntStream.of(input).iterator());
308  }
309
310  /**
311   * Returns List of all matches that have a value.
312   *
313   * <p>The list contains all non-null values for the prefix values where this is true: <code>
314   * input.startsWith(prefix)</code>.
315   *
316   * @param input The string (iterator of Unicode CodePoints) for which we need value of the stored
317   *     prefix.
318   * @return The list of values, an empty List if nothing is found.
319   */
320  Iterator<V> getAllMatches(PrimitiveIterator.OfInt input);
321}
